# vyla-entertainment/sdk
The Vyla SDK (@vyla-entertainment/sdk) is a server-side JavaScript/TypeScript package that provides direct access to Vyla's stream resolvers, health probes, download resolvers, and subtitle providers.

## Installing
To start, install VylaSDK through npm or pnpm:
```bash
# npm
npm install @vyla-entertainment/sdk

# pnpm
pnpm install @vyla-entertainment/sdk
```

View our full documentation at https://docs.vyla.cc/sdk
